title: Mass of block B
description: Essential: Correctly states the mass of block B as 3m.

title: Work against friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total work done by friction on A as (2/15)mgH.

title: Friction coefficient ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the ratio of kinetic friction coefficients as 11/9.

title: Collision analysis
description: Important: Applies momentum and kinetic energy conservation for the elastic collision to relate post-collision velocities to v1 and masses.

title: v-t graph interpretation
description: Important: Uses the v-t graph to determine accelerations (a1, a2) and the post-collision velocity of A (-v1/2).

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to A's motion down and up the incline to relate acceleration, gravity, and friction.

title: Geometry and kinematics
description: Important: Relates displacements on the incline (x1, x2) to heights (H, h) using sinθ and to areas under the v-t graph.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Optional: Sets up energy conservation equations for the system (A and B) before and after the friction coefficient change.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to post-collision velocity of A or misinterprets the direction of acceleration from the v-t graph.

title: Friction force miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Fails to correctly solve for the frictional force (f = mg sinθ / 9) from the Newton's law and kinematic equations.
